title: Kulamalu Park stairs fall lawsuit settlement
summary: On September 29, the Council adopted Resolution 26-147 to settle a lawsuit against the County, with eight ayes and one abstention. The suit stems from a March 8, 2024 incident at Kulamalu Park, where a woman carrying her granddaughter reached for a railing that was not there on the stairs and claims injuries including a fractured hip. A committee backed the settlement 7-0 on September 22, and the Parks director said no stair repairs have been made since.
